events.label: Maryland General Assembly passes Senate Bill 1 on federal agent identification

slots.name: bill status
slots.sentence: The Maryland General Assembly passed Senate Bill 1 in April, seeking to improve transparency of the federal government and make it easier to identify and hold accountable federal immigration agents who break the law.
